# Indicator

A dot or count on the corner of an icon or avatar, such as unread notifications.

## When to use

- Something new behind an icon: unread messages, a pending request.

## When not to use

- Status of an item: use Badge.
- Amounts: never show money in an indicator.

## Behavior and responsive

- `count` shows a number, capped at `max` ("99+"); 0 hides it. `dot` shows a dot without a number.

## Do

- Give a `label` that says what is new: "3 unread messages".

## Don't

- Do not stack several indicators on one element.

## Tokens

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-docs-tokens.ts from the compiled tokens. Do not edit this section by hand. -->

Sizing and radius tokens. Change them in `packages/tokens/build/foundation.ts`; the component CSS reads only these.

| CSS variable | Leeward | Leeward Business | Refers to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--lw-indicator-dot-size` | 8 px | 8 px | `space.xs` |
| `--lw-indicator-count-height` | 20 px | 20 px | `sizer.5xSmall` |
| `--lw-indicator-count-padding-x` | 4 px | 4 px | `space.2xs` |
| `--lw-indicator-radius` | 9999 px | 9999 px | `radius.pill` |

## Accessibility

- The visible mark is hidden from screen readers; a hidden text says what it means, after the element's own name.

## Example

```tsx
import { IconButton, Indicator } from "@leeward/react";

export function Notifications() {
  return (
    <Indicator count={3} label="3 unread notifications">
      <IconButton icon="bell" label="Notifications" />
    </Indicator>
  );
}
```
